NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF LIVING PERSON AS NATIONAL HERITAGE)

ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of

the National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage

(Declaration of Living Person as National Heritage) Order 2019.

Declaration of National Heritage

2. The persons named in column (1) of the Schedule are declared as a National

Heritage in the fields specified in column (2).
